title: UPI Payment App - Send Money
description: Users log in with mobile number and password, then send money to a UPI ID after entering their 4-digit UPI PIN. Daily limit Rs 1,00,000, per-transaction limit Rs 50,000, minimum Rs 1. Three wrong PINs block UPI for 24 hours. A payment fails if the balance is insufficient. Every successful payment sends an SMS and appears in transaction history.

title: Employee Leave Management
description: Employees apply for casual leave (12/year) or sick leave (6/year) with from/to dates and a reason. Weekends are not counted. Half-day is allowed for a single date. title: Account Login and Password Reset
description: Users log in with email and password. After 3 wrong passwords the account is locked for 15 minutes. Forgot password emails a 6-digit code valid for 10 minutes; the new password must be 8-20 characters with an upper-case letter, a digit and a special character, must differ from the last 3 passwords, and confirm must match. Sessions expire after 15 minutes of inactivity.
